question: What substantive field governs the underlying dispute?

entries.definition: Agency authority, rulemaking, adjudication, or judicial review of agency action is central.
Maritime commerce, vessels, seamen, cargo, maritime liens, collision, salvage, or admiralty jurisdiction is central.
Monopolization, restraints of trade, price fixing, market allocation, or merger competition is central.
Bankruptcy, reorganization, automatic stay, discharge, estate administration, or creditor priority is central.
Enforcement or protection of constitutional and statutory civil rights is central.
Business transactions, sales, negotiable instruments, secured transactions, or commercial regulation is central.
Consumer credit, debt collection, credit reporting, deceptive practices, mortgage servicing, or consumer warranties is central.
Contract formation, interpretation, performance, breach, or contractual remedies is central.
Criminal charge, prosecution, plea, conviction, sentence, suppression, or punishment is central.
Student rights, special education, school governance, discipline, access, or education regulation is central.
Environmental review, pollution control, hazardous waste, cleanup liability, natural resources, or species protection is central.
Marriage, divorce, custody, support, adoption, guardianship, or parental status is central.
Healthcare regulation, public programs, provider reimbursement, licensing, privacy, emergency care, or healthcare fraud is central.
Admission, immigration status, asylum, removal, visa, detention, or naturalization is central.
Interpretation, scope, enforcement, regulation, or performance of an insurance policy or insurance relationship is central.
Patent, trademark, copyright, trade secret, or related ownership and infringement is central.
Employment relationship, wages, workplace discrimination, retaliation, labor organization, or collective bargaining is central.
Ownership, title, possession, land use, easement, mortgage, or foreclosure of real property is central.
Securities issuance, registration, disclosure, trading, fraud, or market regulation is central.
Tax liability, deduction, deficiency, refund, assessment, or penalty is central.
Civil liability for negligence, intentional tort, personal injury, causation, or damages is central.
Wills, probate, intestate succession, estate administration, trusts, fiduciary administration, or beneficiary rights are central.
The principal field cannot be represented by another approved practice area.
